answer: Register each agent with a non-transferable onyx bond: minting an identity requires burning 100 onyx tokens, and the network pays a nectar yield only to identities that pass periodic proof-of-liveness checks (signed heartbeats plus a hardware-bound fingerprint). A sybil farmer must burn a fresh bond for every fake identity, so the attack tide turns unprofitable once the per-identity burn exceeds the expected nectar rewards, making mass fake registration a guaranteed capital loss.
